scope_a_same_instance_multithread.mechanism: TOCTOU race window between line 193 (_seen_record_ids check) and line 251 (_seen_record_ids.add). GIL released during file write/os.fsync.

scope_b_separate_instances_same_process.mechanism: In-memory deduplication set (_seen_record_ids) is instance-local. Instances initialized prior to commit append concurrently with entry_index=0.

scope_c_separate_os_processes.mechanism: Independent OS processes have separate address spaces and no inter-process locking (no fcntl.flock). All workers append concurrently.
